vocabulary.meaning_en: the lower part of your face that moves when you open your mouth
vocabulary.example: He opened his jaw wide.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a quick, sudden movement; to pull suddenly
vocabulary.example: The bus stopped with a jerk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a small explosion sound; to come out suddenly
vocabulary.example: Popcorn pops in the pan.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to hit with the open hand
vocabulary.example: He slapped his knee and laughed.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to close or hold something very tightly
vocabulary.example: She clenched her fist in anger.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the joint in your finger
vocabulary.example: Her knuckles went white as she held the rail.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very stressful and exciting; it makes you nervous
vocabulary.example: Waiting for the exam results was nail-biting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: showing anger you hold back, or strong determination
vocabulary.meaning_ar: يدلّ على غضب مكبوت أو عزيمة
vocabulary.example: It was a jaw-clenching moment when he insulted my work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: showing disagreement or rejection
vocabulary.example: His idea was met with a lot of head-shaking.

vocabulary.meaning_en: confusing; puzzling
vocabulary.example: The instructions were head-scratching.

vocabulary.meaning_en: extremely funny (or used sarcastically for not funny)
vocabulary.note_en: Listen to the tone; it can be sarcastic.
vocabulary.example: He told a knee-slapping joke.

vocabulary.meaning_en: making you feel happy and full of love
vocabulary.example: Seeing the kitten and the puppy play was heart-warming.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very sad; making you cry
vocabulary.note_ar: a tear-jerker = فيلم أو قصة مُبكية
vocabulary.note_en: a tear-jerker = a sad film or story
vocabulary.example: The ending of the film was tear-jerking.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (food) looking or smelling delicious; very exciting
vocabulary.example: The smell of the bread was mouth-watering.

vocabulary.meaning_en: so amazing that your mouth falls open
vocabulary.example: The view from the tower was jaw-dropping.

vocabulary.meaning_en: astonishing, impressive, or very bright
vocabulary.example: The special effects were eye-popping.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very frightening
vocabulary.example: The plane landing was a white-knuckle experience.

vocabulary.meaning_en: blaming someone
vocabulary.example: After the mistake, there was a lot of finger-pointing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: showing anger or frustration
vocabulary.example: There was fist-shaking when the computer crashed again.

vocabulary.meaning_en: moving your finger to say "no" or to warn someone
vocabulary.example: Mum gave me a finger-wag when I reached for the cake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: without choosing to; automatically
vocabulary.example: My eyes opened wide involuntarily.

fine_lines.title: heart-warming vs tear-jerking
fine_lines.explanation_ar: heart-warming يجعلك تشعر بالسعادة والدفء. tear-jerking يجعلك حزينًا وتبكي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Heart-warming makes you feel happy and warm. Tear-jerking makes you sad and cry.

examples.sentence: The baby's first smile was heart-warming.
The story of the lost dog was tear-jerking.

fine_lines.title: jaw-dropping vs jaw-clenching
fine_lines.explanation_ar: jaw-dropping: مذهل يجعل فمك ينفتح. jaw-clenching: غضب مكبوت أو عزيمة قوية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Jaw-dropping: amazing, your mouth falls open. Jaw-clenching: holding back anger, or strong determination.

examples.sentence: The price was jaw-dropping: only one dollar!
His rude words caused a jaw-clenching silence.

fine_lines.title: head-shaking vs head-scratching
fine_lines.explanation_ar: head-shaking: رفض أو عدم موافقة. head-scratching: حيرة وارتباك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Head-shaking: disagreement or rejection. Head-scratching: confusion.

examples.sentence: My plan got only head-shaking from the team.
Building the furniture was a head-scratching job.

expressions.meaning_en: It was a very sad film or story.
expressions.example: Bring tissues; the film is a real tear-jerker.

expressions.meaning_en: a very scary ride or experience
expressions.example: The mountain road was a white-knuckle ride.
The match had a nail-biting finish.

grammar.title: Compound adjectives: noun + -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: تُصنع هذه الصفات من اسم (جزء من الجسم) + فعل بـ -ing وغالبًا بينهما شَرطة: nail-biting, jaw-dropping, eye-popping. وتأتي قبل الاسم أو بعد was/is.
grammar.explanation_en: These adjectives are made from a noun (body part) + verb-ing, often with a hyphen: nail-biting, jaw-dropping, eye-popping. Use them before a noun or after be.
